stem: The lengths, in millimetres, of rods produced by a machine are normally distributed with mean $\mu$ and standard deviation 0.9. A random sample of 75 rods produced by the machine has mean length 300.1 mm.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find a 99% confidence interval for $\mu$, giving your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: The manufacturer claims that the machine produces rods with mean length 300 mm.
parts.text: Use the confidence interval found in part **(i)** to comment on this claim.
